question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**cycle**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the overall life of a Banana.
 
• The blank 1 in the sentence will imply the period of the life of the Banana.
 
• Now, among the given options, the correct word to use is** "cycle.**"
 
 
• **"Cycle" **refers to a sequence of events that repeat in a specific order.(चक्र)
 
• The word is commonly used to describe the process of something repeating itself.
 
 
• **Example**: *The cells are shed over a **cycle**__ of twenty-eight days.*
 
 
 
 
 
• In this context, **"cycle"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Hence,** **the correct answer is** option 3**.
 
• **Correct passage**:

The life __**cycle**__ of a banana is a colourful one; it starts with a deep green, changes to a delicious yellow and ends at an unappetizing brown. Bananas, like most fruits, produce and ______ (2) ______ with an airborne hormone called ethylene. This hormone helps to signal the ripening process. An unripe fruit is hard and acidic. It is likely to possess a greenish ______ (3) ______ due to the presence of chlorophyll. When a fruit comes into contact ______ (4) ______ ethylene, the acids in the fruit start to break down, it becomes softer and the green chlorophyll is ______ (5) ______ and replaced, in the case of bananas, with a yellow hue.
